name: STAR Orbit — coverage geometry of a satellite over a spherical body
summary: Earth-central angle, nadir angle, slant range, covered fraction, footprint area and elevation for a satellite at a given altitude and minimum elevation; agrees with pymap3d and PROJ on a sphere to 1e-13 and keeps precision from 1 mm of altitude to 1e12 km.
reference: Textbook geostationary geometry (Wertz, Space Mission Analysis and Design): from 35 786 km the central angle to the horizon is 81.3 deg, the nadir angle 8.7 deg, the slant range 41 679 km, 42.4 % of the surface in view; 76.3 deg at 5 deg of elevation; horizon at 2294 km from 400 km

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: central_angle_deg, nadir_angle_deg, slant_range, coverage_fraction, footprint_area, elevation_deg
review.G-04: degrees; lengths in the unit of the radius (km by default); radius overridable, tested in metres and for the Moon
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input and for geometry that cannot be resolved; no iteration
